name: 액운
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single production-quality transparent inventory item icon for Joseon Hunters, a Korean Joseon dark-fantasy isometric ARPG. This is physical inventory object art with the tactile, sober craftsmanship and realistic material readability of classic Diablo II Resurrected inventory objects. Follow the project's H1 matte form grouping, Korean materials, and restrained dark-fantasy tone.
Output: one isolated object only, centered on a genuinely transparent background, square canvas, preferably 1024 by 1024. Entire object and its silhouette visible, generous transparent margins of about 12 percent, no clipping, no extra props. Clean detailed painterly realism with simple readable large forms; must remain legible reduced to a 40-pixel inventory cell. Three-quarter near-frontal product view; very slight tilt only. One soft upper-left neutral light, controlled local material highlights, no harsh studio shine. Separate dark forms through quiet local value contrast. No ground plane or environmental backdrop, no border, no UI, no lettering or labels, no watermark.
Materials must feel handmade: rough Korean hanji paper, faded vermilion cinnabar pigment, worn textile, iron and carved stone only where the subject specifies them. No glossy plastic, cartoon emoji, pixel art, glowing outlines, halo, bloom, flames, light beams, or game-skill effects. No legible Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Latin text or numbers, no actual written characters: any ink motifs must be abstract non-linguistic brush gestures. No Japanese omamori pouch, torii, oni horn, samurai ornament, European medieval fantasy metalwork, or random luxury jewels.

Primary subject: A rare cursed Korean talisman slip made of substantial aged amber hanji, twice as tall as wide, slightly bitten and darkened at its lower edges, paper still intact and usable. One dominant dark vermilion jagged broken-spiral ink mark with two heavy hooked brush ends, abstract and non-linguistic. Ominous compact silhouette, old crimson pigment, subtly scorched fibers; controlled contrast so the paper stays visible in a dark inventory. Crafted tier-three physical artifact, no smoke, no flames, no creature, no magic glow, no decoration obscuring the brush motif.
processing: unchanged master copy; premultiplied-alpha resize and transparent padding only
